title: BattleReadyShelf Faction Export
description:
The authoritative contract for the JSON document accepted by POST /api/v1/admin/factions/import (and produced by GET /api/v1/admin/factions/export). This is the canonical source of truth for this contract - other repositories producing an import document (e.g. battlereadyshelf-dataset) must conform to it. It mirrors the 'FactionExport' schema in backend/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml; if the two ever disagree, the OpenAPI spec wins and this file should be updated to match.

Factions are the first of the three definition documents to import: model definitions reference factions by the ids named here, so importing models before factions is rejected.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this export document's schema. Must be within the backend's supported range (see ExportSchema) or the import is rejected. All three definition documents share one version.

exportedAt.description: Set by the backend on export; ignored if present on import.

datasetVersion.description: Optional version of the source dataset assembled into this document.

factions.description: Upserted by stable source id directly (no draft/publish workflow - factions carry no army-building rules, purely catalogue organisation/filtering). The document is authoritative for a faction it names: a parentFactionId it omits is cleared.

id.description: Stable identifier used to match this faction across imports.

parentFactionId.description: The id of the parent faction, which must be defined in this same 'factions' list. Null/absent for a top-level faction.
